verdict.rationale: Zero's repo documents an official MCP server (ZeroMCP, MCP.md) with a broad tool surface: reading threads, listing folders, composing, sending and deleting emails, label management, bulk actions, search, and AI mailbox Q&A. Agents connect via a Better Auth session token, with OAuth marked 'coming soon'. Missing for 10: OAuth-based connection (not yet shipped, only token auth today), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection, and detailed client setup docs beyond a staging-branch MCP.md.
